C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting (e.g., a/b -> x/LCD)
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Work only rewrites a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Subtract fraction quantities
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction once terms are in compatible form (like denominators or separated whole/fraction parts), including subtracting numerators and combining results.
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts two fractions with like denominators by subtracting numerators
Subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately and then combines (when no borrowing is needed)
Computes the final difference after conversion to improper fractions
exclusion_criteria: The key operation is borrowing/regrouping because the fractional part would be negative (tag S04)
The key operation is simplifying/reducing the result (tag S03)

skills.name: Rewrite and simplify forms
skills.definition: Rewrite numbers into an equivalent convenient form (mixed ↔ improper, whole ↔ fraction, or reduce a fraction) and express the final result in simplest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (or interprets a nonstandard mixed number like 1 4/3)
Rewrites a whole number as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 4 = 12/3)
Reduces/simplifies a fraction (including simplifying to 0 or an integer) or simplifies an input fraction before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Finding an LCD and converting both fractions to that LCD (tag S01)
Borrowing/regrouping from the whole part to fix a negative fractional subtraction (tag S04)

skills.name: Borrow/regroup in subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing 1 from the whole part (or rewriting a whole number) to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative, then continue the subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Fractional part subtraction is negative and the solution borrows 1 from the whole part
Solution rewrites a whole number as (whole−1) plus a full fraction (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3) specifically to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: No borrowing/regrouping is needed because the fractional part is already large enough
Only converts mixed numbers to improper fractions and subtracts directly without regrouping

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (or use a given one) and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts one or more fractions to an equivalent form with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Work only simplifies a fraction (e.g., 4/10 to 2/5) without creating a common denominator between two different denominators

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions once they have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution performs (a/b) − (c/b) = (a−c)/b
Includes cases where the result is 0/b before simplification
exclusion_criteria: Subtraction is done on whole-number parts of mixed numbers only
The key operation is borrowing/regrouping rather than the actual numerator subtraction

skills.name: Mixed/whole rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers into a form that enables subtraction (e.g., convert mixed to improper, or express a whole number with a fractional part/denominator).
inclusion_criteria: Convert a mixed number to an improper fraction (or interpret an unconventional mixed number like 1 4/3)
Rewrite a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 4 = 12/3) or as a mixed number with 0/n
exclusion_criteria: Borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional difference (tag S04 instead)
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction without changing representation type (tag S02/S01 or neither as appropriate)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Regroup (borrow) from the whole part when the fractional subtraction is negative and/or simplify the final numeric form (reduce fractions, convert 0/b to 0, combine whole+fraction).
inclusion_criteria: Solution borrows 1 from a whole part to make the fractional part nonnegative (adds b/b to the fraction)
Solution reduces a fraction to lowest terms (e.g., 9/12 to 3/4) or simplifies 0/b to 0
Solution combines whole and fractional parts into a final mixed number after subtraction/regrouping
exclusion_criteria: Only finds a common denominator (S01) or only subtracts numerators with like denominators (S02) without any regrouping/simplification/combining
Only converts mixed to improper or whole to fraction without borrowing or simplifying (S03)

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (or a target denominator) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
Solution rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 4 = 12/3)
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction (e.g., 4/10 to 2/5) without establishing a common denominator for subtraction

skills.name: Subtract fractional quantities
skills.definition: Compute the difference once quantities are expressed compatibly (e.g., like denominators), including subtracting numerators and handling zero results.
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts two fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators
Subtracts improper fractions with the same denominator
Produces intermediate results like 0/3 or negative fractional differences (before regrouping)
exclusion_criteria: Only converts forms (LCD, improper conversion) without performing the subtraction
Only simplifies/reduces a fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Mixed/whole number rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers into a form suitable for subtraction (e.g., improper fractions, or separating whole and fractional parts with matching denominators).
inclusion_criteria: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (e.g., 3 1/2 = 7/2)
Interprets a mixed number with an improper fractional part (e.g., 1 4/3 = 7/3)
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a zero fractional part (e.g., 3 = 3 0/5) to align parts
exclusion_criteria: Only finds an LCD and converts proper fractions (that is S01)
Only performs borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional part appears (that is S04)

skills.name: Regrouping (borrowing) in subtraction
skills.definition: When the fractional part of a mixed-number subtraction is negative, borrow 1 from the whole part and add one whole (e.g., d/d) to the fraction part to continue the subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Shows a negative fractional difference (e.g., 0/5 − 1/5 = −1/5) and then borrows from the whole part
Explicitly adds a full unit fraction (e.g., 5/5, 12/12, 24/24) after decreasing the whole part by 1
Recomputes the fractional subtraction after borrowing
exclusion_criteria: Subtraction does not require borrowing because the fractional part is nonnegative
Only simplifies the final fraction (e.g., 9/12 = 3/4) without any borrowing step
